title: Round 25b: round 25's net2 on net1 v9 means, training seeds 4 to 6 (replication)
description: Replication declared after the single test run exp-dagger-twins-test-258 and before any new result: three more training seeds (4 to 6) of each DAgger twin, trained with the identical recipe, then judged at the iterations already chosen in exp-dagger-twins-iter-val-256 (r25-means after iteration 19, r26-u0.25 after 39, r26-u0.375 after 59), nothing re-chosen: first on the validation links at campaign seed 21, then once on the test links beside the first three seeds. This file trains round 25's recipe unchanged (experiments/net2-r25-v9.json: round 18's DAgger gate3 students, teacher gain 0.5, the rule on net1 v9 at u = 0.25, 60 iterations, validation every 20) on net1 v9 (exp-net1v9-243), reading the means only, at training seeds 4, 5 and 6. Validation links only; no claim from this release on its own.
run: S="$OUT/spec-r25-$VIEW-s$SEED.json"; jq --arg view "$VIEW" --argjson seed "$SEED" '.algo = "dagger" | .student = {"kind": "gate3", "threshold": 0.5} | .view = $view | .share_k = 0.5 | .critic_warmup = 0 | .lr = 0.001 | .updates_per_iteration = 50 | .replay_iterations = 16 | .tau_s = 1 | .noise_sigma = 0.05 | .group = 1 | .links_per_iteration = 32 | .compete = 0.8 | .copies = [2, 4] | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 60 | .eval_every = 20' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r25-$VIEW-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
